column1: # UnitTypeSlots batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Slots were derived by cross-comparing the two rulesets, which keep real unit names: TsfRuleset
# line 41 and DsfRuleset line 85 both build a UnitTypeSlots. Slots a,c,d,e,g,h,i,k,l,n,o,p,q hold
# the SAME unit in both (General, BattleTank, Artillery, MissileTank, BaseStation, Shipyard,
# Airfield, Transport, Carrier, FighterPlane, Helicopter, Cruiser, Submarine), so those names are
# certain. Slot m is Tsf Airship / Dsf Chinnook: both fly and both carry ground units, hence the
# Six rows stay blank on purpose: b (Tsf BattleTank but Dsf Humvee), r (Destroyer vs Gunboat),
# and f/j/s/t whose Tsf value is null (4x4, OilField, Mechanic, Hovercraft exist only in Dsf),
# so no ruleset-independent meaning can be established. Note getter t() reads field u.
